title: Dream Beat Liberty 92-82 to Lead Semifinals 1-0
meta_description: New York led 40-37 at half. Atlanta won the third quarter 32-15 and beat the Liberty 92-82. The Dream lead 1-0.
hook: This is the Game 1 recap of the WNBA semifinals, the New York Liberty at the Atlanta Dream. The Liberty led 40-37 at halftime and made all 15 free throws, and Atlanta still won the third quarter 32-15. DeWanna Bonner's night off the bench is in the scoring lines below.
summary: Review draft of the WNBA semifinals Game 1 recap. Atlanta Dream 92, New York Liberty 82, on October 4, 2026, at State Farm Arena. Atlanta leads the series 1-0. Stats are from the ESPN box score for game 401918295.
hero_image_alt: Angel Reese of the Atlanta Dream in a white jersey, number 5, looking to her right
hero_image_credit: Photo: John McClellan / CC BY-SA 4.0. Wikimedia Commons file: Angel Reese Dream (cropped).jpg. Taken May 9, 2026, at Target Center.
unique: New York led 40-37 at halftime, then Atlanta won the third quarter 32-15
New York made 15 of 15 free throws and lost by 10
DeWanna Bonner scored 23 points with 9 rebounds off the bench
unverified: No quotes were added. The only injury wording beyond the box score is the ESPN game-page recap line that Allisha Gray went down with a left hand injury in the second quarter.
The lead photo is from May 9, 2026, at Target Center, not from this game.
